# Why are so many slide decks [so bad]{.emphasis}? {background-color="var(--divider-bg)"}


## normative conformity

> "the tendency of individuals to adjust their behavior, attitudes, or beliefs to align with the perceived standards or expectations of a group or society"


## normative conformity…for slide decks

> "the tendency of employees to adjust their presentations to align with the perceived standards of their organization"


## normative conformity…illustrated {.statement}

"This slide deck is killing me."

. . .

"Let me produce another one."
